secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Required for the Gemini models to answer in the app; the Anthropic models in the model picker need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic Claude API key (https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Optional: only needed for the Claude models in the model picker.
